pages.title: Finding the altar
pages.text: Search new terrain on the outer End islands for broken rings above an eight-pointed base. The long stair faces inland; rear points face the void. In the End use /locate structure tinkersnewlife:starwell_arena.

pages.title: Calling Momo
pages.text: The Ender Dragon must have been defeated at least once in this save. Stand within 20 blocks of the center of a naturally generated altar and finish eating $(l:relic_rlyeh_call)R'lyeh Call$(). A pasted template lacks the required structure record.

pages.title: Entrance
pages.text: The underground beacon base completes. At about 4.5 seconds the center blasts players outward; $(l:momo_battle)Momo$() appears at about 5.5.

pages.title: No duplicate bosses
pages.text: Rituals cannot overlap at one altar. Another boss within 256 blocks in this dimension blocks spawning, even if registered but unloaded.

pages.title: The beacon vault
pages.text: Let the boss finish her death blast inside the altar. Descend the side passage to the beacon. Expect 3–5 reward chests, fewer if spaces are occupied.

pages.title: Before another kill
pages.text: Empty them before the next kill: old reward chests and contents are replaced. Player-placed containers stay.

pages.title: Vault contents
pages.text: Each chest rolls 5–15 times independently for minerals, relics, End materials and more. It can hold at most one random flying sword; all its parts use materials of tier 2 or higher.
